description: Claude Code plugins by Iván Velasteguí

plugins.name: ref-links
plugins.description: Every PR, issue or ticket Claude cites is a markdown link carrying its number and title

plugins.name: explain-tickets
plugins.description: Explains a chain of tickets in execution order: what each one asked for and what came out of it

plugins.name: evidence-research
plugins.description: Evidence-first research method: frame the decision, start from prior work, close every unknown with a source, verify, and deliver a sourced recommendation

plugins.name: value-proposition
plugins.description: Research-first value proposition method: one customer, their real alternatives, provable value, many drafts, a 13-point checklist and a 5-second test

plugins.name: subject-lines
plugins.description: Data-backed method for cold email subject lines: short, one real personal attribute, specific to the reader's world, checked against sourced rules and judged on reply rate
